tasks.label: build
args: set -euo pipefail; cd "${workspaceFolder}"; OUT="${workspaceFolderBasename}"; if ls src/*.cpp >/dev/null 2>&1; then SRC=(src/*.cpp); else SRC=(*.cpp); fi; /usr/bin/clang++ -std=c++20 -fcolor-diagnostics -fansi-escape-codes -g "${SRC[@]}" -o "$OUT" -framework CoreMIDI -framework CoreFoundation
